messages.author: 4ace66cb95fe8bbb
messages.subject: Deploy private shiny app
parts: Is there a way to deploy an app to a paid shiny io account so that the app is private when it deploys? I know I can manually change this in the account settings after deploying the app, but I am hoping there is some sort of argument in deployApp that is not listed in its description (the description lists many of the arguments, but the argument list for deployApp ends with ...). I also do not see a setting in the account where I can ask it to deploy my apps as private by default.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Deploy private shiny app
parts:
I don't believe we have that feature.  It is something I have wanted in the past, but nobody had asked for it so we held off on it.  Would love to hear if others also find themselves wanting this.

-Tareef

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Deploy private shiny app
parts:
We actually have that feature! We've been meaning to write a blog entry about it, but we haven't gotten around to it. 

Anyway, if you have the latest version of shinyapps package you can use these functions:

addAuthorizedUser()
removeAuthorizedUser()
showUsers()
showInvited()

Hope that helps!
-Andy
